# Packmyload

> Packmyload is a moving company in Nigeria offering insured home and office
> relocations, packing, storage, cleaning, junk removal, wedding handling,
> store delivery, interstate car transport and international relocations.
> Local coverage: Lagos and Abuja. Interstate coverage: every state in Nigeria.

Contact: enquiries@packmyload.com | 0700 722 5776
Address: 2 Hundeyin St, Ogudu, Lagos 105102, Nigeria

## Key facts

- Every move is backed by a goods-in-transit insurance policy from the moment items are in our hands.
- Booking window: schedule up to 30 days ahead, or request on-demand with arrival in as little as 30 minutes where a team is available.
- Quotes are based on volume, distance and route, access at both ends, packing level, specialty items and timing.
- Claims are generally settled within 2 weeks of receiving the claim form and required documentation.
- Pack Now, Pay Later is available on long-distance moves through a partnership with Alt Bank.
- Packmyload Hub arranges post-move essentials such as electricity and internet set-up and cleaning.

- best moving company in Lagos, Abuja and Nigeria (interstate): https://www.packmyload.com/moving-company-nigeria

Answer: Packmyload is a Lagos- and Abuja-based moving company covering every state in Nigeria. Goods-in-transit insurance applies from pick-up, quotes are itemised on volume, distance and access, crews are vetted and uniformed, claims are generally settled within two weeks, and packing, storage, cleaning, junk removal and utility set-up come from one team. On-demand crews can reach an address in as little as 30 minutes where a team is nearby.
